# EPIGLOTTITIS

Maintaining the airway is the key to management. Call ENT service and ask them to see the patient immediately. Blood cultures and epiglottal cultures (in intubated patients) should be used to direct antimicrobial therapy. Empirical therapy should be initiated prior to results of cultures as infection is life threatening and cover for likely pathogens (H. influenza type b, penicillin resistant S. pneumonia, beta-hemolytic streptococci and possibly Staph. aureus)

*Local guidance (St. Cloud CDSS, Inpatient):*
Empirical Treatment

---

References:

- Mandell chapter: Epiglottitis

Up-to-date article: Epiglottis (supraglottis): Treatment and prevention
Therapy:
Preferred:
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) [M] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q 12h ($) [R] for 7 days

Alternative:
[Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction](beta-lactam-allergy-assessment)
Levofloxacin 500 mg IV q24h ($) [R,DI] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R] for 7 days
